Question1:
Write a Java program to check whether a number is a Spy Number.
A number is a Spy Number if the sum of its digits is equal to the product of its digits.
Example:
1124 → Sum = 1+1+2+4 = 8
Product = 1×1×2×4 = 8
Sample Output:
Enter a number: 1124
Sum of digits = 8
Product of digits = 8
1124 is a Spy Number

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_SpyNumber {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		int num=1124;
		int num2=num;
		int original=num;
		System.out.println("Enter a number: "+num);
		int sum=0;
		int product=1;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastDigit=num%10; //4
			sum=sum+lastDigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Sum of digits = "+sum);
		for(;original>0;)
		{
			int lastDigit1=original%10;
			product=(product*lastDigit1);
			original=original/10;
		}
        System.out.println("Product of digits = "+product);
        if(sum==product);
        {
        	System.out.println(num2+" is a Spy Number");
        }
	}

}

Output:
Enter a number: 1124
Sum of digits = 8
Product of digits = 8
1124 is a Spy Number

Question2:
Enter a number: 1124
Sum of digits = 8
Product of digits = 8
1124 is a Spy Number
Sample Output:
Enter a number: 172

Digit Sum = 10
Final Digit = 1

172 is a Magic Number

Code:
package dailyAssignment;

public class Program_MagicNumber {

	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		int num=172;
		int original=num;
		System.out.println("Enter a number: "+num);
		System.out.println();
		System.out.println();
		int sum=0;
		int finalDigit=0;
		for(;num>0;)
		{
			int lastDigit=num%10; //4
			sum=sum+lastDigit;
			num=num/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Digit Sum = "+sum);
		
		for(;sum>0;)
		{
			int lastDigit1=sum%10;
			finalDigit=finalDigit+lastDigit1;
			sum=sum/10;
		}
		System.out.println("Final Digit = "+finalDigit);
		System.out.println();
		System.out.println();
		if(finalDigit==1);
		{
			System.out.println(original+" is a Magic Number");
		}

	}

Output

Enter a number: 172


Digit Sum = 10
Final Digit = 1


172 is a Magic Number
